summary: DeepSeek-V4-Flash Vision serves its lossless FP4-CSF checkpoint by default
compatibility: CHECKPOINT=original serves the original checkpoint as before. An image whose vLLM lacks the deepseek_v4_flash MXFP4-CSF family serves the original with a warning.
details: CHECKPOINT=csf (default) or original chooses the DeepSeek-V4-Flash Vision checkpoint: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp-lossless-CSF holds the same weights as the original with losslessly compressed routed-expert scales, which stay compressed in GPU memory.
Measured with the profile settings on two RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q: KV cache 1,850,842 instead of 1,306,708 tokens (+42%), decode within 3% per verification step, prefill -1.4% / -2.9% at 8K / 32K tokens.
